description: Budget Fit - Automatically downgrade trip elements (stay tier, transport mode, paid activities) to fit user's budget. Add city cost tiers to destinations and update cost calculations.
steps: 1. Add costTier ('metro' | 'tier-2' | 'hill' | 'beach') and costMultiplier (number) fields to Destination interface in src/data/destinations.ts. Update all 6 existing destinations (goa, jaipur, hampi, ladakh, kerala, pondicherry) with appropriate values: metro=1.5, tier-2=0.8, hill=1.3, beach=1.2.
2. Update calculateAccommodationCost() in src/utils/plannerLogic.ts to multiply base costs (budget: 1500, mid: 3500, luxury: 8000) by destination.costMultiplier.
3. Update calculateTransportCost() in src/utils/plannerLogic.ts to multiply base costs (bus: 800, train: 1500, flight: 5000) by destination.costMultiplier.

4. Create src/utils/budgetOptimizer.ts with fitToBudget(itinerary, targetBudget) function. Implement three-tier optimization: (1) downgrade stay tier (luxury→mid→budget), (2) downgrade transport (flight→train→bus), (3) remove paid activities starting with highest cost. Return BudgetFitResult with adjustedItinerary, changes array (type, from, to, savedInr), and finalCost.
5. Add calculateOweSummary helper in budgetOptimizer.ts that recalculates total cost after adjustments and updates costBreakdown.totalEstimatedInr, varianceInr, and budgetStatus.
6. Create src/components/BudgetFitModal.tsx that displays proposed changes before applying. Show table of adjustments (Stay: Luxury→Mid, Save ₹12,000), new total cost, and Apply/Cancel buttons.

7. Add 'Fit to My Budget' button to src/components/TripPlanner.tsx, visible only when costBreakdown.varianceInr < 0 (over budget). On click, call fitToBudget and show BudgetFitModal. On Apply, update itinerary state with adjusted version and show success toast with total savings.

8. Add unit tests in src/utils/budgetOptimizer.test.ts covering: only stay downgrade needed, stay+transport downgrade, all three adjustments, edge case where budget is impossible to meet (verify closest fit returned).
acceptance_criteria: All 6 destinations in destinations.ts have costTier and costMultiplier fields
Cost calculations in plannerLogic.ts use destination.costMultiplier
Fit to My Budget button appears when totalEstimatedInr > userBudgetInr
Clicking button shows modal with specific changes and savings amounts
Algorithm tries downgrades in order: stay tier, then transport, then activities
Apply button updates itinerary and shows toast 'Budget optimized! Saved ₹X'
Final cost is at or below target budget (or closest possible)
All unit tests pass including new budgetOptimizer tests (npm run test)
verification: npm run lint - TypeScript strict mode passes
npm run test - all tests pass including budgetOptimizer.test.ts
Manual: Generate trip with budget ₹20,000 but select luxury stay and flight (should exceed budget)
Manual: Verify 'Fit to My Budget' button appears in red/warning color
Manual: Click button, verify modal shows specific downgrades (e.g., Luxury→Mid stay)
Manual: Click Apply, verify itinerary updates, cost breakdown shows new total under budget
Manual: Verify toast shows actual savings amount
